symptom: On Mendix 10.24 / 11.6 projects mxcli writes properties those versions do not declare — CustomWidgets$WidgetValueType.AllowUpload on every pluggable widget property, Forms$PageVariable.SubKey, Rest$RestOperation.QueryParameters, Navigation$OfflineEntityConfig.CompatibilityMode, PublishedAttribute.EdmType and a dozen more. `mx check` passes; `mx convert` silently strips them; Studio Pro resolves every stored property against the type and cannot open such a document, and its next save differs from mxcli's in property names (mendixlabs/mxcli#1373)
cause: Writers emit keys unconditionally — empty lists from codec MandatoryLists defaults, false flags, empty strings, and values the writer derives (EdmType, IsMany) — with no notion of the project's version; only a handful of writers had hand-made version gates
file: `modelsdk/canon/propertyfloor.go` (`StripUndeclaredProperties`: drop an empty key below its version, refuse a valued one) + `modelsdk/canon/studiopro_property_floors.json` (measured floors for keys the metamodel data lacks), version data copied as plain data into `modelsdk/version/metamodel_versions_gen.go` (`go generate ./modelsdk/version`; drift test `modelsdk/gen/version_copy_test.go`), wired in `modelsdk/mpr/writer_core.go` `normalizePropertySets` and the read-back; `mdl/backend/modelsdk/odata_write.go` `publishesMemberTypes` gates the derived EdmType/IsMany; `modelsdk/gen/webservices/types.go` RpcMessagePartElement accessors renamed
insight: **Drop what is empty, refuse what holds a value — and let writers gate what they derive**: an empty key below its version is exactly what `mx convert` produces, so dropping loses nothing, while a value is something the statement said that the version cannot store. But a generic refusal cannot tell user intent from a writer-derived value: the first run refused every published OData service on 11.10–11.12.0 because the writer always computes EdmType/IsMany — those had to be gated in the writer. **The storage layer cannot import gen for its version data** (gen imports it), and importing every gen package elsewhere runs their init, which registers codec factories for 23 packages nothing loaded before — and one of them panicked: RpcMessagePartElement's `TypeName` property shadowed element.Base's $Type accessors. So the data is copied, with a drift test. **Measure floors from Mendix-authored content too**: a fresh `mxcli new` project already holds Mendix's full property sets, so a key present in the base project on 11.12.0 but not on 11.11.0 is a floor measured without writing anything
